about: ai-co2 tips: test cases. Written by "node tips.check.verified.mjs --write". Do not edit by hand. Each case is one made-up person: "input" is what pickTips gets, "expect" holds what the page must show with no tip applied and, where there are tips, with the first one applied. Texts only, so a port passes when its printed sentences are the same.

cases.name: Heavy Opus user (the statistics fixture A)

tips.title: About 85% of your estimate comes from Opus 5.5
body: Moving half of your Opus 5.5 work to Sonnet would save
how: for a hard problem. Each choice also becomes your default for new sessions. Switch at the start of a task: after a switch, Claude reads the whole conversation again without its cache.
tips.switchLabel: Sonnet for half of your Opus work

tips.title: 95% of your tokens are earlier text being read again
body: A third less re-reading would save
how: when you switch to an unrelated task. Claude Code then starts a new conversation, so there is less to read again at every step. To stay on the same task with a shorter history, type
at a natural break in your work.
tips.switchLabel: A third less re-reading

tips.title: Opus and Sonnet wrote 5 million tokens for you, thinking included
body: A fifth less writing and thinking on Opus and Sonnet would save
how: at the start of a simple task: Claude then thinks and writes less. How much less depends on the task. The level stays, also in later sessions, until you change it.
goes back to the model’s own level.
tips.switchLabel: A fifth less writing and thinking
